# Distance

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Great-circle distance in km between two lng/lat points (haversine).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "distance", "name": "distance", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `lng1` | `expr` | `"lng"` |  |
| `lat1` | `expr` | `"lat"` |  |
| `lng2` | `expr` | `"r_lng"` |  |
| `lat2` | `expr` | `"r_lat"` |  |
| `name` | `string` | `"km"` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->

|------|------|
